title: 第五课 · 我介绍一下儿
subtitle: Lesson 5 — 我介绍一下儿 · Let Me Introduce — Introductions, 的, locations & visiting

items.en: to look; to watch; to read

items.py: Wǒ shì Zhāng lǎoshī de xuéshēng.
Mǎlì: Wáng Lán, tā shì shuí?
items.en: Mary: Wang Lan, who is he?

items.zh: 王兰：玛丽，我介绍一下儿，这是我哥哥。
items.py: Wáng Lán: Mǎlì, wǒ jièshào yíxiàr, zhè shì wǒ gēge.
items.en: Wang Lan: Mary, let me introduce — this is my older brother.

items.zh: 王林：我叫王林。认识你，很高兴。
items.py: Wáng Lín: Wǒ jiào Wáng Lín. Rènshi nǐ, hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: Wang Lin: My name is Wang Lin. Nice to meet you.

items.zh: 玛丽：认识你，我也很高兴。
items.py: Mǎlì: Rènshi nǐ, wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: Mary: Nice to meet you too.
Wang Lan: Where are you going?

items.zh: 玛丽：我去北京大学。你们去哪儿？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ qù Běijīng Dàxué. Nǐmen qù nǎr?
items.en: Mary: I'm going to Peking University. Where are you going?
Wang Lin: We're going to the shop.

items.py: Hézǐ: Zhāng lǎoshī zài jiā ma?

items.zh: 和子：我是张老师的学生，我姓山下，叫和子。你是……
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ shì Zhāng lǎoshī de xuéshēng, wǒ xìng Shānxià, jiào Hézǐ. Nǐ shì...
items.en: Kazuko: I'm Teacher Zhang's student, my surname is Yamashita, my name is Kazuko. You are...?

items.zh: 小英：我叫小英。张老师是我爸爸。请进！
items.py: Xiǎoyīng: Wǒ jiào Xiǎoyīng. Zhāng lǎoshī shì wǒ bàba. Qǐng jìn!
items.en: Xiaoying: I'm Xiaoying. Teacher Zhang is my dad. Please come in!

items.py: Tā shì shuí? —— Tā shì wǒ gēge.
items.en: Who is he? —— He's my older brother.

items.py: Tā shì shuí? —— Tā shì wǒ péngyou.
items.en: Who is he? —— He's my friend.

items.py: Tā shì shuí? —— Tā shì wǒ tóngxué.
items.en: Who is he? —— He's my classmate.

items.py: Nǐ qù nǎr? Wǒ qù shāngdiàn.
items.en: Where are you going? I'm going to the shop.
I'm going to the internet bar.
I'm going back to the dorm.
I'm going back to the classroom.
A: Are you going to the shop?

items.zh: B: 我不去商店，我回宿舍。
items.py: B: Wǒ bú qù shāngdiàn, wǒ huí sùshè.
items.en: B: I'm not going to the shop, I'm going back to the dorm.
A: Is David in the dorm?

items.zh: B: 不在，他在三〇二教室。
items.py: B: Bú zài, tā zài sān líng èr jiàoshì.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Verb Predicate, 的 & 是 Sentences)

items.en: I go to the shop. (verb predicate: S + V + O)
Teacher Zhang is at home. (verb predicate with 在)
my dad (的 omitted for close family)
his mom (的 omitted for close family)
my older brother (的 omitted for close family)
He is a teacher. (是 sentence: S + 是 + N)
He is not a teacher. (negative: S + 不是 + N)

items.zh: 他是老师吗？——是，他是老师。
items.py: Tā shì lǎoshī ma? —— Shì, tā shì lǎoshī.
items.en: Is he a teacher? — Yes. (是 question with 吗)

items.py: Wǒ bú shì lǎoshī, wǒ shì xuéshēng.
items.en: I'm not a teacher, I'm a student. (是 contrast)
introduce briefly (expression to read and use)
know who (expression to read and use)
go to the shop (expression to read and use)
mom's friend (expression to read and use)
Wang Lan's older brother (expression to read and use)

items.py: Tā qù nǎr? Tā qù jiàoshì.
items.en: Where is he going? He's going to the classroom.

items.py: Tā shì shuí? Tā shì wǒ de tóngxué.
items.en: Who is she? She is my classmate.

items.zh: 王老师在宿舍吗？不在，他在教室。
items.py: Wáng lǎoshī zài sùshè ma? Bú zài, tā zài jiàoshì.
items.en: Is Teacher Wang in the dorm? No, he's in the classroom.

items.zh: 你去超市吗？我不去超市，我回宿舍。
items.py: Nǐ qù chāoshì ma? Wǒ bú qù chāoshì, wǒ huí sùshè.
items.en: Are you going to the supermarket? No, I'm going back to the dorm.

items.py: Qǐng jièshào yíxiàr, tā shì shuí?
Zhè shì wǒ péngyou, tā jiào Mǎlì.
items.en: This is my friend, her name is Mary.

items.zh: 他是我的老师。→ 谁是你的老师？
items.py: Tā shì wǒ de lǎoshī. → Shuí shì nǐ de lǎoshī?
items.en: He is my teacher. → Who is your teacher? (interrogative pronoun drill)

items.py: Tā xìng Wáng. → Tā xìng shénme?
items.en: Her surname is Wang. → What is her surname? (interrogative pronoun drill)

items.zh: 她叫京京。→ 她叫什么名字？
items.py: Tā jiào Jīngjīng. → Tā jiào shénme míngzi?
items.en: Her name is Jingjing. → What is her name? (interrogative pronoun drill)

items.zh: 她认识王林。→ 她认识谁？
items.py: Tā rènshi Wáng Lín. → Tā rènshi shuí?
items.en: She knows Wang Lin. → Who does she know? (interrogative pronoun drill)

items.zh: 王老师去教室。→ 王老师去哪儿？
items.py: Wáng lǎoshī qù jiàoshì. → Wáng lǎoshī qù nǎr?
items.en: Teacher Wang goes to the classroom. → Where does Teacher Wang go? (interrogative pronoun drill)

items.zh: 玛丽在宿舍。→ 玛丽在哪儿？
items.py: Mǎlì zài sùshè. → Mǎlì zài nǎr?
items.en: Mary is in the dorm. → Where is Mary? (interrogative pronoun drill)

items.zh: 我介绍一下儿，我叫玛丽，我是美国留学生。那是大卫，他是我的朋友，他也是留学生，他是法国人。刘京、王兰是我们的朋友，认识他们我们很高兴。
items.py: Wǒ jièshào yíxiàr, wǒ jiào Mǎlì, wǒ shì Měiguó liúxuéshēng. Nà shì Dàwèi, tā shì wǒ de péngyou, tā yě shì liúxuéshēng, tā shì Fǎguó rén. Liú Jīng, Wáng Lán shì wǒmen de péngyou, rènshi tāmen wǒmen hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: Let me introduce: my name is Mary, I'm an American exchange student. That is David, he's my friend, he's also an exchange student — he's French. Liu Jing and Wang Lan are our friends; we're very happy to know them. (listen-and-retell passage)
Please sit down for a moment.

items.py: Rènshi nǐ, wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng.

items.en: to go back to the dorm
You are...? (polite way to ask who someone is)
